newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank of Lebanon forex reserves up at end March.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Lebanon forex reserves up at end March.

text.p: The Bank of Lebanon's gross foreign exchange reserves rose $30.71 million in the second half of March to $6,321.49 million according to the central bank's bi-monthly balance sheet published on Wednesday.
This followed a rise of $29.41 million in the first half of March to $6,290.78 million.
Gross reserves include commercial banks' foreign exchange deposits with the central bank.
The balance sheet did not give the central bank's net reserves but banking sources told Reuters they stood at $4,310 million at end of March.

Net reserves were $4,280 million at end of February and they did not increase in the first half of March. They stood at $4,015 at the end of 1996 compared with $2,858 million a year earlier. They were $2,732 million at the end of 1994.
